name: Maulvi Liaquat Ali
contribution: Maulvi Liaquat Ali led rebel forces in Allahabad during the 1857 uprising and briefly challenged Company authority in the city.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His role shows how the rebellion created short-lived local administrations and armed challenges beyond its best-known centers.
highlight: Maulvi Liaquat Ali led the uprising in Allahabad during the wider rebellion of 1857.
seoTitle: Maulvi Liaquat Ali: Allahabad in the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Maulvi Liaquat Ali's leadership in the Allahabad uprising during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
shortAnswer: Maulvi Liaquat Ali was a rebel leader who challenged Company authority in Allahabad during the 1857 uprising.
